status: locally frozen before execution; exploratory, not external preregistration
method: Parameterized matching: two substrings have the same equality pattern under a consistent injective renaming of letters; implementation uses exact canonical seed codes and literal extension, not a parameterized suffix tree
method_reference: B.S. Baker, Parameterized Pattern Matching: Algorithms and Applications, JCSS 52(1), 1996, DOI 10.1006/jcss.1996.0003
left_target: DSS Torah-labelled islands from WIT-001-A1 with simple fragment label, no critical flags, length >=12; verify archived island hash and original source manifest; retain witness duplicates and all source slot coordinates
right_target: all SBLGNT verses in fixed catalog order, each kept separate; normalized letter tokens retain word boundaries for word-order control
normalization: existing Hebrew normalization, final forms folded to 22 letters; existing Greek normalization to 24 letters; no gaps filled and no match across separate left islands or Greek verses
score: maximum exact parameterized-match length, capped at 64, over both directions, all eligible source units, all right units and all substring starts; zero means no match of length at least 12, not longest match zero
search_accounting: record both oriented left seed-start count and right seed-start count, their product, actual equal-pattern seed pairs extended, and all global maximum occurrences; inferred mappings are selected inside every randomized scan too
mapping_policy: injective partial map uniquely determined on the source symbols occurring in a reported substring; undefined on unused source symbols; no edit operations or position-dependent maps
cost: Record ceil(log2(left oriented starts))+ceil(log2(right starts))+6 length bits+sum(log2(24-i),i=0..d-1) for d distinct source symbols; this ideal conditional index/table cost excludes grammar, normalization, decoder and provenance, whose byte sizes are also reported; never interpret as absolute complexity or probability
references: shuffle all Greek letters independently within each existing right unit
shuffle whole Greek word tokens independently within each existing right unit, retaining within-word letters
p_value: inclusive upper tail (1 + reference maxima >= observed maximum)/(B+1); rescan every position, direction and mapping for every reference
reference_limit: Neither within-verse model is a universal human-authorship null; the word control protects existing words, not phrase order, deliberate encoding or historical dependence
full_control_pairs: Mishnah Berakhot source blocks versus Xenophon prefix before first gap, grouped in consecutive 16-word units
same selected DSS islands versus all Swete Torah verses
target_exploration: EXP-002, executed only after CAL-004 passes
candidate_screen: maximum length at least 24 and both p-values <=0.01; if passed retain all tied occurrences for adversarial review, not confirmation or proof; cap hits are explicitly censored, and uniqueness must be checked separately
hypothesis_scope: local monoalphabetic substitution only, no claim to cover translations, phonetic rules, insertions inside a match, arbitrary algorithms, or all divine-signature hypotheses
historical_limit: No selected island has independent photographic collation or certified letter-level chronology yet; separate transcripts of the same passage are not independent occurrences
